reason: I've never paid for a creator tool. vidIQ, TubeBuddy and YouTube Studio already give me numbers for free, and ChatGPT tells me what to post. I don't have time to read another dashboard, and a monthly report by email is one more thing I'll skip.
objection: It's another analytics layer on top of the free tools I already use, and I can't tell from this what it knows that YouTube Studio doesn't.
would_change_my_mind: A clear free trial that shows me, on my own channel, a specific video I should repost or a title that would have beaten my last ten, in Hinglish, with no sign-up hassle.
